headlines.title: Funeral services held for Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: Watch live coverage of the funeral services held for Sen. Lindsey Graham at the U.S. Capitol and Washington National Cathedral. President Trump and Vice President Vance will be among the speakers at the two services.

headlines.title: A major earthquake strikes southern Japan
headlines.description: The Japan Meteorological Agency said the earthquake, with a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 and a depth of just over 6 miles, was at the highest end of the seismic intensity scale. NBC News' Raf Sanchez reports on the initial damage caused by the earthquake.

headlines.title: Bryan Kohberger Looks to Withdraw Guilty Plea in Idaho Murders
headlines.description: Bryan Kohberger, the man who admitted to the 2022 killings of four University of Idaho students as part of a plea deal, is now saying he wants his plea to be withdrawn. It comes as a Netflix series is set to premiere with new interviews from the victims’ family members. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports and legal analyst Danny Cevallos joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Manhunt for suspect in deadly shootout at Seattle food festival
headlines.description: Police also arrested a 15-year-old who they said was one of the gunmen. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Influencer allegedly killed by husband after accusing him of pedophilia on TikTok, police say
headlines.description: A social media influencer was allegedly killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records. Sara Gilson was fatally shot Thursday in Oklahoma by husband Jeremiah Duffey, who went by Shawn Duffey on social media, according to the Owasso Police Department. She was 43.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Washington says goodbye to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: A special ceremony at the Capitol and a funeral service at the National Cathedral on Tuesday will be private, but both events will be livestreamed for the public.

headlines.title: Major earthquake rocks southern Japan, injuring dozens
headlines.description: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake rocked southern Japan Tuesday, forcing hundreds of thousands of people to evacuate and prompting the collapse of several buildings, including a shopping mall.

headlines.title: Michigan dad fatally shoots his wife and 6 kids before killing himself, authorities say
headlines.description: The bodies were found Friday inside the Grand Haven residence, police said, and the children were 5 to 15 years old.

headlines.title: The second of two red panda cubs born at a California zoo dies
headlines.description: The second of two red panda cubs born at the Santa Barbara Zoo in California this summer died over the weekend, the zoo said Monday.

headlines.title: 15-year-old shot into Seattle food festival crowd during deadly gunfight, prosecutors allege
headlines.description: A judge ordered a 15-year-old held in juvenile detention Monday in connection with a gunfight at a crowded Seattle food festival that killed three people and injured at least four others.

headlines.title: How to prevent boob sweat, according to experts
headlines.description: Beyond making you uncomfortable, boob sweat can cause painful sweat rashes under the breasts. Experts share the best boob sweat solutions and how to treat intertrigo.
